pages.title: Blue light · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eleven in the morning at a big aquarium in Monterey. Blue light fills long dark halls. Huge tanks hold colorful fish and slow turtles. Dina walks in with her camera and a map. A guide in a navy shirt stands near a big tank. Her name tag says Marin.
“Welcome to the aquarium! Do you have any questions?” says Marin. “Yes. Can I touch the fish?” says Dina. “No, you can’t touch the fish in the big tanks.” says Marin.

pages.title: Blue light · 3/3
paragraphs: “I understand. And can I eat inside?” says Dina. “You can’t eat in the galleries. Please use the cafe.” says Marin. Dina touches a starfish with one finger. Respect keeps wild homes safe.
